items.title: Strip Centers Anchored by the Weekly Grocery Run: $90,000 Across These 3 Owners Pays $3,862 a Year
items.summary: Every week, shoppers fill carts at Publix and Kroger, and the landlords next door collect rent from the salon and burrito shop. Three REITs turn that routine into quarterly checks, but each carries a scar from 2020 and a risk worth knowing.

items.summary: Mall, grocery-anchored, and open-air landlords are packing in tenants at levels not seen in years, and each of these three REITs just raised its payout. One simple number tells you whether the checks will keep coming.
